product_metadata.title: Küchenprofi Stainless Steel Handle for Eggs, Batter, and Dough, Metal Whisk for Kitchen Use, Silver, 10 Inches
features: QUALITY KITCHEN WHISK: A versatile tool for everyday cooking, this multipurpose whisk has a head that’s shaped perfectly for beating eggs or blending batters and sauces. Made of durable stainless steel for a lifetime of use, it features an ergonomically designed handle and hanging hook for easy storage.

COMFORTABLE ERGONOMIC WHISK: This whisk features an ergonomic handle designed to sit comfortably in the palm of your hand. This handle is very easy to hold and provides a secure grip, which gives better control over the tool. A better grip, allowing more control means less splatter and mess while you are whisking, and less cleanup later.

PREMIUM MATERIALS & DESIGN: All Küchenprofi tools are made of superior quality stainless steel. This means that your new whisk is not only attractive, but is also durable, corrosion resistant, and dishwasher safe. This professional whisk has been designed for convenience. It features a hanging hook on the handle for easy storage.

VERSATILE KITCHEN ACCESSORY: When it’s time to whip eggs for a gourmet French souffle or for a weekday breakfast scramble, you’ll appreciate Küchenprofi's attention to detail in this stainless steel whisk. It will become your favorite kitchen tool for everything from beating eggs, to mixing pancake batter to whipping up the perfect cream sauce.

TRADITION OF QUALITY: Küchenprofi was founded in Germany in 1923. Designing exemplary items has distinguished this brand as one of the best in the industry. Frieling has partnered with this brand since 2017 and proudly brings its premium quality hand tools, salt and pepper mills, and more to the US market.
